messages:
Sam Lee: Hey team — quick personal update: I've accepted a promotion to Director of Engineering! :tada: Also adopted a corgi this weekend, meet Biscuit. Will be bringing Biscuit to the office Tue afternoon. Thoughts?
Nina Patel: OMG congrats on both!! :tada::puppy: When's the puppy debut??
Omar Chavez: Massive congrats Sam! director, woo. Puppy pics pls.
Sam Lee: Thanks y'all! Biscuit is 10 weeks, very friendly. Planning Tue around 2pm for a quick hello at the open seating.
Hugo Tran: Love it. We do have a quiet-room noise concern — could we do a short visit in the foyer? Also bring treats maybe.
Jen Park: People Ops might need to sign off. @people-ops-bot what's our office pet policy? :eyes:
people-ops-bot: Hi! Quick reminder: service animals ok, pets allowed with manager approval and vaccination proof. Please submit the pet-visit form: https://intranet/redwood/pets
Lina Gomez: I'll bring puppy treats from the cafe. Also cake? We should celebrate the Director title :cake:
Ben Ortiz: +1 cake. Banana bread for Biscuit? jk :smiley:
Sam Lee: Submitted the form already, thanks. Cake sounds perfect. 2pm in the foyer then — quick intro and then Biscuit goes home. 
Nina Patel: RSVP: yes to cake and puppy cuddles. 
Omar Chavez: Count me in. Can someone bring a camera? we'll dunk Sam in confetti. :confetti_ball:
Jen Park: I'll coordinate with Facilities for a mat and water bowl. Congrats again Sam!!
Sam Lee: Thanks friends — appreciate all the support. See you Tue (and bring napkins).
